controls.name: order-three subgroup is not the target
controls.reason: y_1 is fixed by g squared but is not fixed by g.

controls.name: order-two subgroup is not the target
controls.reason: x_1 is fixed by g cubed but is not fixed by g.

controls.name: product action is not diagonal action
controls.reason: Changing the first factor alone does not fix the coordinate ratios.

controls.name: old model-side open product is sufficient
controls.reason: It permits a point with x_1 cubed equal to zero, outside the original x_1*y_1 nonzero chart.

controls.name: generic integrality proves full affine integrality
controls.reason: For each cube root epsilon, s=0,w_3=epsilon is a dimension-five vertical component of the unsaturated A7 intersection.

controls.name: a square pairing ratio must be a cube
controls.reason: Its valuation at the specified prime divisor is two.

controls.name: repeated fivefold base parameters remain smooth
controls.reason: At r=t two coefficient columns become proportional; the generic smoothness proof does not apply.

controls.name: all plane-cubic specializations are smooth
controls.reason: Generic smoothness is established by a nonempty open, not every coefficient triple.

controls.name: bad generic fibers obstruct rational total spaces
controls.reason: The two graph morphisms have rational total fields and respectively elliptic and general-type generic fibers.

controls.name: all mod-p counts certify characteristic-zero degree one
controls.reason: The exact degree drops from two to one on reduction.

controls.name: finite distinct-point sampling certifies degree one
controls.reason: Each sampled fiber has one distinct point but length two; the generic degree is two.
